summary: Only crypto traded through Sunday's close: bitcoin held its 30-day uptrend near 6.7% gains and stayed comfortably above its 200-day average, though light weekend volume let ether outpace it. Stocks, bonds and gold simply carried Friday's levels, still pinned by a firmer dollar and elevated real yields that left gold oversold and bonds pressured by the TLT slide.
tweet: Bitcoin was the only market open this weekend, extending its uptrend as ether outpaced it, while gold, bonds and stocks sat frozen at Friday's dollar-and-yield-pressured close.
